1.web: Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
1.asv: They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.

2.web: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
2.asv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.

3.web: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
3.asv: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.

4.web: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
4.asv: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.

5.web: But as for those who turn aside to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
5.asv: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
